findings.description: Insulation cladding damaged and displaced over a 2 m section of the vapour line. No metal loss detected at this stage.
findings.recommendation: Reinstate cladding and seal joints to prevent water ingress.

findings.description: Localised external corrosion observed on shell plate adjacent to support saddle. Coating breakdown over approximately 0.4 m² with visible rust scaling.
findings.recommendation: Remove loose scale, surface prepare to St-3 and re-apply approved coating system during next available shutdown.

findings.description: Support saddle anchor bolt at south-west location found loose. No structural distress observed.
findings.recommendation: Re-torque anchor bolt to specification and record in maintenance log.

findings.description: Ladder and platform grating adjacent to manway found corroded with section loss exceeding 20% at two treads.
findings.recommendation: Replace affected grating sections before next internal inspection.

findings.description: Minor external scaling and paint chalking on head section. No measurable metal loss.
findings.recommendation: Include in routine painting schedule. No immediate action required.
